note: fixed literature-specified configurations; genuine XGBoost; no tuning. Comparator weights are library defaults (unweighted); this is an auxiliary configuration benchmark; primary GBM is fixed Cand4 after cohort exploration, not a nested-tuned model.
imputation_detail: binary training-mode, other training-median, scaler training-only
bootstrap_scope: conditional patient bootstrap; not full model retraining bootstrap
